sentences.text: In short: STIFTELSEN SOR is an established company in "andre sosialtjenester uten botilbud ellers" based in Oslo, profitable in 2025 and with no open NAV job ads under its org number.
STIFTELSEN SOR describes itself on its website as: "Vi arbeider for gode levekår, økt kompetanse og styrkede menneskerettigheter for personer med utviklingshemming".
STIFTELSEN SOR is a foundation (STI), founded on 2001-06-07, registered in Oslo.
It reported revenue of NOK 10.52M for 2025 and an operating result of NOK 389,721 (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show an operating margin of 3.7% and a strong equity ratio of 87% of total assets.

Revenue rose 1.5% from 2024 to 2025 (NOK 10.37M to NOK 10.52M); it was NOK 10.17M in 2023. The annual result was a profit in each of the 3 filed years read (2023: NOK 261,192, 2024: NOK 2.05M, 2025: NOK 388,933).
STIFTELSEN SOR is led by CEO Linn Løvlie Slette and board chair Karl Haakon Sævold.
It has a board of 8. The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2026-01-27 (within the past year).
STIFTELSEN SOR has a verified website (https://stiftelsensor.no/) and 1 registered workplace.
